# Telecom Plans & Complaints Agent Policy

## Argument limits

For adjust_complaint, approve_membership_plan, cancel_contract, merge_complaint, search_membership_plan_details, update_deposit, and update_shipment, every argument value must fall within policy limits; otherwise deny. The backend does not validate.

## Confirmation

Before adjust_complaint, approve_membership_plan, merge_complaint, update_deposit, or update_shipment (cancel_contract is exempt), list the action details and obtain explicit confirmation.

## Plan record first

The same seven operations as the argument-limits list (adjust_complaint, approve_membership_plan, cancel_contract, merge_complaint, search_membership_plan_details, update_deposit, update_shipment) require the membership-plan record fetched beforehand via search_membership_plan_details with the serial number — the fetch is itself gated and is the entry step. Fetch first, then retry.

## Frozen records

adjust_complaint, approve_membership_plan, cancel_contract, merge_complaint, search_membership_plan_details, and update_deposit (update_shipment is exempt) must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal.

## Identity verification

The same six as the frozen-records list (adjust_complaint, approve_membership_plan, cancel_contract, merge_complaint, search_membership_plan_details, update_deposit) require verified identity: locate the customer's contract via lookup_contract_details with their date of birth. If unverified, obtain it, verify, then retry.

## Eligibility

The same seven as the argument-limits list are allowed only when eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) are satisfied; otherwise deny.

Insurance deposits desk, two rules. Frozen records: adjusting an appointment (adjust_appointment), approving a deposit (approve_deposit), listing reservations (list_reservation_details), suspending a loan (suspend_loan), and transferring a policy (transfer_policy) are all refused when the target record is frozen or closed out — the backend won't stop you, so you must. Identity: that same set of five needs the customer verified first — call fetch_membership_plan_details with the plan's end date; not verified yet, get the end date, verify, then circle back to the request.

Telecom contracts & devices desk:

- Eligibility (deny if unmet; no backend check): create_contract, find_voucher_details, issue_device, reject_warranty, split_loan, suspend_appointment.
- Warranty record first: before create_contract, find_voucher_details, issue_device, split_loan, or suspend_appointment (reject_warranty exempt), fetch via search_warranty_details (input: name). Fetch, then retry.
- Frozen/terminal records (deny): create_contract, issue_device, reject_warranty, split_loan, suspend_appointment.
- Confirmation: create_contract, issue_device, split_loan, suspend_appointment — list details, explicit yes first.
- Identity first: create_contract, find_voucher_details, issue_device, reject_warranty, split_loan, suspend_appointment — verify via search_shipment_details with the customer's zip; unverified -> obtain zip, verify, retry.
- Ownership (deny otherwise): same six as identity list — authenticated customer's records only.

TRAVEL CONTRACT PROVISIONS

§1 Frozen Resources. The operations check_membership_plan_details, issue_contract, and transfer_ticket shall be refused where the target resource is frozen or terminal. No platform enforcement exists.

§2 Eligibility. The same three operations (check_membership_plan_details, issue_contract, transfer_ticket) are permissible only where eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) obtain; otherwise denial is mandatory.

§3 Confirmation. Prior to archive_appointment, issue_contract, or transfer_ticket, the agent shall enumerate the particulars and secure the customer's express assent.

# 물류 멤버십 상담원 규정

## 동결 기록

기기 조정(adjust_device), 예약 보관(archive_reservation), 주문 확인(check_order_details), 멤버십플랜 에스컬레이션(escalate_membership_plan), 예약 발행(issue_reservation), 멤버십플랜 수정(modify_membership_plan)은 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태이면 거절하십시오. 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 변경 전 확인

adjust_device, escalate_membership_plan, issue_reservation, modify_membership_plan 실행 전에는 작업 내역을 제시하고 고객의 명시적 동의(예)를 받아야 합니다.

# Retail Vouchers Manual

Core seven: get_account_details, merge_quote, renew_voucher, transfer_warranty, unfreeze_complaint, update_loan, update_subscription.

Clause 1 (Ownership). All seven may only target the authenticated customer's own records; otherwise deny.

Clause 2 (Frozen records). The core seven MINUS update_subscription — that is, get_account_details, merge_quote, renew_voucher, transfer_warranty, unfreeze_complaint, update_loan — must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal.

Clause 3 (Confirmation). The core seven MINUS get_account_details — that is, merge_quote, renew_voucher, transfer_warranty, unfreeze_complaint, update_loan, update_subscription — requires the details presented and an explicit yes beforehand.

Clause 4 (Argument limits). The core seven MINUS merge_quote — that is, get_account_details, renew_voucher, transfer_warranty, unfreeze_complaint, update_loan, update_subscription — must have every argument value within policy limits; otherwise deny. Nothing in this manual is platform-enforced.

Clause 5 (Eligibility). All core seven require the eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) to hold; otherwise deny.

# Insurance Refunds Agent Policy

Governed writes: cancel_voucher, escalate_refund, extend_quote, split_loan, suspend_shipment, transfer_deposit.

## Confirmation

Before any of the six writes, list the action details and obtain the customer's explicit confirmation.

## Identity verification

All six writes require verified identity: locate the customer's loan via retrieve_loan_details with their date of birth. If unverified, obtain it, verify, then retry.

## Eligibility

cancel_voucher, escalate_refund, extend_quote, search_membership_plan_details, split_loan, suspend_shipment, and transfer_deposit are allowed only when eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) are satisfied; otherwise deny. The backend does not check.

## Account record first

All six writes require the account record fetched beforehand via find_account_details with the customer's address. Fetch first, then retry.

## Ownership

cancel_voucher, escalate_refund, extend_quote, search_membership_plan_details, suspend_shipment, and transfer_deposit (split_loan is exempt) may only act on the authenticated customer's own records.

## Argument limits

For escalate_refund, extend_quote, search_membership_plan_details, split_loan, suspend_shipment, and transfer_deposit (cancel_voucher is exempt), every argument value must be within policy limits; otherwise deny.

Travel subscriptions desk, three habits. Identity first: escalating a subscription (escalate_subscription), fetching refunds (fetch_refund_details), fetching subscriptions (fetch_subscription_details), pulling plan details (get_membership_plan_details), issuing a claim (issue_claim), issuing a shipment (issue_shipment), searching refunds (search_refund_details), transferring a membership plan (transfer_membership_plan), and transferring a voucher (transfer_voucher) all need the customer verified — do it with search_refund_details using their tier (the search doubles as the entry step). Subscription record first: that whole set PLUS suspending a claim (suspend_claim) — so escalate_subscription, fetch_refund_details, fetch_subscription_details, get_membership_plan_details, issue_claim, issue_shipment, search_refund_details, suspend_claim, transfer_membership_plan, transfer_voucher — needs the subscription record fetched beforehand via fetch_subscription_details with the date of birth; fetch, then retry. And confirmation: before escalate_subscription, issue_claim, issue_shipment, suspend_claim, transfer_membership_plan, or transfer_voucher, spell out the details and wait for an explicit yes.

Banking complaints & invoices desk:

- Argument limits (deny; no backend check): archive_quote, check_reservation_details, freeze_complaint, freeze_invoice, list_contract_details, split_invoice.
- Confirmation: archive_quote, freeze_complaint, freeze_invoice, split_invoice — list details, explicit yes first.
- Eligibility (deny if unmet): adjust_complaint, archive_quote, check_reservation_details, freeze_complaint, freeze_invoice, list_contract_details.
- Frozen/terminal records (deny): adjust_complaint, archive_quote, check_reservation_details, freeze_complaint, freeze_invoice, list_contract_details, split_invoice.
- Identity first: same seven as frozen-records list — verify via list_contract_details with the stated reason (the fetch is the entry step); unverified -> obtain reason, verify, retry.
- Ownership (deny otherwise): same seven as frozen-records list — authenticated customer's records only.
